content.introduction: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released several economic indicators as of October 4, 2026. The Employment Cost Index (ECI) increased by 0.9% in the second quarter of 2026. Productivity saw a 1.4% increase in the same period. The U.S. Import Price Index rose by 0.7% in August 2026, and the U.S. Export Price Index increased by 0.6% in the same month. The latest releases include monthly state employment and unemployment data, access to and use of leave, productivity and costs by industry, employment projections, worker displacement, and county employment and wages. The sources don't provide a definitive answer to specific questions not directly addressed.
